answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works when each identity must post collateral before acting. A bonded registry makes every agent lock a fixed copper-denominated stake, and each new identity must also solve a sequential puzzle seeded by a quartz beacon, so clones cannot be mined in parallel. Ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand full locks and ten thousand serial solving runs; the price per pseudonym never falls, while honest agents recover their stake on exit. Weighted by stake times age, a late canyon of fresh agents can swing nothing.
